'''2005 Norwegian National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship in Norway (April 2005). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Norway
* '''Dates:''' April 2005
